newsitem.title: ITALY: Pavarotti plans pop record with Michael Jackson.
newsitem.headline: Pavarotti plans pop record with Michael Jackson.

text.p: Italy's king of opera Luciano Pavarotti said on Monday he was planning a record with U.S. pop star Michael Jackson and other artists.

"We've started talking about it," the burly tenor told reporters in his northern Italian hometown of Modena, where he and Spanish opera singers Jose Carreras and Placido Domingo will perform together on Tuesday night.
Jackson, one of the top-selling pop stars in history, is expected to be in the audience to hear the "Three Tenors", whose regular concerts have helped broaden opera's appeal.
Pavarotti, who topped pop charts with his version of the Puccini aria "Nessun Dorma", said he enjoyed the concerts so much he would gladly switch for good.
"If it were up to me, I'd swap my opera duties to tour with the Three Tenors," he said.
"Personally, I enjoy myself more being up on stage with those two extraordinary singers and friends."
